question: What meditative focus secures accomplishment of the mantra?
premises: Hākinī is described as moon-faced and eternal
The purpose of this meditation is mantra accomplishment
inference: One should meditate on the eternal moon-faced Hākinī to attain mantra accomplishment
uncertainties: Legacy hint glossed śaśi+mukhīṃ as hare-faced; taken here as moon-faced based on śaśi
plain_english: One should meditate on the eternal, moon-faced Hākinī for the accomplishment of the mantra.
